subject: Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 API release, 2026-09-01
central_claim: Claude Fable 5.1 is a publishable AI engineering topic because Anthropic's announcement, Claude Platform model page, release notes, what's-new page and migration guide support a bounded E2/R1 claim: the release changes long-running agent implementation not just through model capability claims, but through API/runtime rules for prompt caching, append-only history, thinking block binding, forced tool-use removal, per-message effort and data-retention constraints. Benchmark superiority remains Anthropic-authored and is not promoted to an independent ranking conclusion.

selection.reason: Fable 5.1 is not the freshest model signal in the crawl, but DeepSeek V4.1-Flash was already staged as the 2026-09-11 candidate with the same central claim. Fable 5.1 remains publishable for 2026-09-12 because the official documentation gives concrete migration decisions for agent developers: remove forced tool use, preserve append-only histories for thinking blocks and prompt cache, retune effort, handle fallback and check data-retention conditions. The conclusion is bounded because no model execution, benchmark reproduction or independent evaluation was performed.

claims.claim: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.1 as a long-horizon agent model and the publishable engineering significance is that its API/runtime contract changes how developers should keep history append-only, preserve prompt cache and thinking blocks, avoid forced tool choice, tune effort by turn and handle data retention; this is not an independently verified claim that Fable 5.1 is generally superior to competing models.

Opened Anthropic's Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 announcement. It identifies the two models, explains that they share a base model with different safeguards, states that Fable 5.1 is generally available while Mythos 5.1 is trusted-access only, and discusses performance, safety, safeguards, data retention and pricing.

Opened the Claude Fable 5.1 model page. It records API model ID claude-fable-5-1, 1M token context, 128K max output, input/output pricing, cache read pricing, default effort, knowledge cutoff, platform availability, release date and retirement commitment.

Opened the what's-new page. It documents the release's API behavior: forced tool use is not supported, earlier models cannot read Fable 5.1 thinking blocks, editing earlier turns invalidates thinking blocks, per-message effort and turn-scoped system messages are beta features, progress updates can be displayed, cache read pricing changed, and content provenance is added.

Opened the migration guide. It gives concrete migration guidance for Messages API code, including replacing forced tool_choice, keeping histories append-only, checking prefix mismatches with beta controls, using server-side compaction or context editing and retuning effort.

Opened Claude Platform release notes. The September 1 entry records the Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 launch, cache-read pricing, tool_choice limitations, thinking block preservation rules, per-message effort, turn-scoped system messages, progress updates and watermarking. September 10 Managed Agents permission-policy updates were also reviewed as a separate infrastructure alternative.

Opened Anthropic's Enterprise Frontier Safeguards announcement. It supports the article's data-retention and enterprise deployment context, especially customer-owned storage, automated monitoring, phased rollout and temporary zero data retention for eligible customers until EFS is ready.

Opened Google/DeepMind Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber announcement, model page, API latest-model page and evaluation methodology PDF. It is an important September 2026 model release with API and benchmark methodology details, but it is older than the latest run signals and less directly actionable than Fable 5.1's migration contract for developers already running long agent sessions.
